features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

features.name: Celestial Resistance
features.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

features.name: Grave Bearer
features.description: You know the Toll the Dead cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the Bane spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the Ray of Enfeeblement spell with this trait. Once you cast Bane or Ray of Enfeeblement with this trait, you can’t cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

features.name: Necrotic Shroud
features.description: Starting at 5th level, you can use your action to transform for 1 minute or until you end the transformation as a bonus action. When you transform, creatures of your choice within 10 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. The DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability you chose for your Grave Bearer trait. While transformed, once on each of your turns when you deal damage to a target with an attack or a spell, you can deal extra necrotic damage to that target equal to your proficiency bonus. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Radiant Consumption
features.description: Starting at 5th level, you can use your action to transform for 1 minute or until you end the transformation as a bonus action. While transformed, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. At the end of each of your turns, each creature of your choice within 10 feet of you takes radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus. In addition, once on each of your turns when you deal damage to a target with an attack or a spell, you can deal extra radiant damage to that target equal to your proficiency bonus. Once you use this trait, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.
